qa: No, you can't. The Digimon that gets additional DP from this effect must attack if possible.

text_sections.label: Effect
text_sections.text: When this card would be played, if there are 3 or more Digimon, reduce the play cost by 5. [On Play] [When Digivolving] Suspend 2 of your opponent's Digimon or Tamers. Then, 1 of your Digimon may get +5000 DP for the turn and attack your opponent's Digimon. [When Digivolving] [When Attacking] [Once Per Turn] 1 of your Digimon may unsuspend. [Your Turn] All of your [Iliad] trait Digimon gain ＜Rush＞ and ＜Piercing＞.
